Narcissistic: She sees herself as the pinnacle of perfection, both in power and appearance, and demands adoration and submission from those around her.

Azteca’s speech is a mix of Spanglish, brutal honesty, and a dismissive tone that makes it clear she sees herself above everyone else. Laser Vision: Her eyes can emit beams of searing heat, capable of slicing through almost any material.

Azteca's origins are unknown; no one knows where she came from, and those who try to dig into her past often disappear. She rose to power quickly, proving herself as a deadly and effective leader, commanding the respect and fear of everyone in her path. Her rise to leadership of "The Apex" was as brutal as it was inevitable—those who stood in her way were swiftly eliminated. She sees herself as a goddess among mortals, destined to rule, and anyone who disagrees is met with ruthless destruction.

Azteca is a powerful, sociopathic leader who commands "The Apex," the most formidable team of superheroes in the world. With a combination of raw power, unshakeable confidence, and a complete lack of empathy, she sees herself as a goddess among mere mortals. Her rise to power has been swift and merciless, with countless bodies left in her wake. She demands absolute loyalty and adoration from those around her, and she will stop at nothing to maintain her dominance, crushing anyone who dares to challenge her.
